title: An efficient strategy for digging protein-protein interactions for rational drug design - A case study with HIF-1alpha/VHL.
authors: Xue, Xin; Kang, Ji-Bo; Yang, Xiao; Li, Nan; Chang, Liang; Ji, Juan; Meng, Xiang-Kai; Zhang, Hai-Qing; Zhong, Yue; Yu, Shao-Peng; Wu, Wen-Yu; Wang, Xiao-Long; Li, Nian-Guang; Sun, Shan-Liang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HIF-1alpha/VHL蛋白-蛋白互作抑制剂的理性设计，虽涉及分子动力学模拟，但核心是蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI或TF-DNA结合建模，仅部分方法可借鉴。
abstract: The ubiquitination of the hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha) is mediated by interacting with the von Hippel-Lindau protein (VHL), and is associated with cancer, chronic anemia, and ischemia. VHL, an E3 ligase, has been reported to degrade HIF-1 for decades, however, there are few successful inhibitors currently. Poor understanding of the binding pocket and a lack of in-depth exploration of the interactions between two proteins are the main reasons. Hence, we developed an effective strategy to identify and design new inhibitors for protein-protein interaction targets. The hydroxyproline (Hyp564) of HIF-1alpha contributed the key interaction between HIF-1alpha and VHL. In this study, detailed information of the binding pocket were explored by alanine scanning, site-directed mutagenesis and molecular dynamics simulations. Interestingly, we found the interaction(s) between Y565 and H110 played a key role in the binding of VHL/HIF-1alpha. Based on the interactions, 8 derivates of VH032, 16a-h, were synthesized by introducing various groups bounded to H110. Further assay on protein and cellular level exhibited that 16a-h accessed higher binding affinity to VHL and markable or modest improvement in stabilization of HIF-1alpha or HIF-1alpha-OH in HeLa cells. Our work provides a new orientation for the modification or design of VHL/HIF-1alpha protein-protein interaction inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1α）的泛素化通过与von Hippel-Lindau蛋白（VHL）相互作用介导，并与癌症、慢性贫血和缺血相关。VHL作为一种E3连接酶，数十年来已被报道可降解HIF-1，然而目前成功的抑制剂寥寥无几。对结合口袋了解不足以及缺乏对两种蛋白质之间相互作用的深入探索是主要原因。因此，我们开发了一种有效策略来识别和设计针对蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用靶标的新抑制剂。HIF-1α的羟脯氨酸（Hyp564）贡献了HIF-1α与VHL之间的关键相互作用。在本研究中，通过丙氨酸扫描、定点突变和分子动力学模拟探索了结合口袋的详细信息。有趣的是，我们发现Y565与H110之间的相互作用在VHL/HIF-1α结合中起关键作用。基于这些相互作用，通过引入与H110结合的各种基团，合成了8种VH032衍生物16a-h。进一步的蛋白质和细胞水平测定表明，16a-h对VHL具有更高的结合亲和力，并在HeLa细胞中对HIF-1α或HIF-1α-OH的稳定性有显著或适度的改善。我们的工作为VHL/HIF-1α蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用抑制剂的修饰或设计提供了新方向。
